label: real site, strict check
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 12 Market Street, city Springfield, ZIP 62701, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone 555 010 0199. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Cookie consent dialog blocks the page at first and must be dismissed before anything else; it is clear enough (Accept/Decline/Manage preferences).

findings.page: The Full Stack Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: Product shows in the featured list with a normal price but is sold out; only the disabled Sold out button on the product page reveals this, so I wasted a step.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: Variant options (Color, Size, Binding mount) are unnamed-state links, with no indication which one is selected; Ember colour link has only an image label.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: After Add to Cart the cart dialog first showed empty-cart text and no confirmation; the item appeared only after re-reading. No clear announcement that the item was added.
Card number, expiration, security code and name on card are iframes with no accessible name in the tree, only text labels beside them, so they cannot be targeted by role and name.
Express checkout buttons are unnamed iframes; the Province dropdown first listed Spanish provinces for a US address, then changed to US states after the page updated, which is confusing.
Labels are plain text next to fields instead of tied to them, and the Address field is a combobox with no hint; Pay now button was disabled until the email was filled with no explanation.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: Variant options (Color, Size, Binding mount) are unnamed-state links, with no indication which one is selected; Ember colour link has only an image label.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: After Add to Cart the cart dialog first showed empty-cart text and no confirmation; the item appeared only after re-reading. No clear announcement that the item was added.
Card number, expiration, security code and name on card are iframes with no accessible name in the tree, only text labels beside them, so they cannot be targeted by role and name.
Express checkout buttons are unnamed iframes; the Province dropdown first listed Spanish provinces for a US address, then changed to US states after the page updated, which is confusing.
Labels are plain text next to fields instead of tied to them, and the Address field is a combobox with no hint; Pay now button was disabled until the email was filled with no explanation.
